name: Springtide Sacrament
source:
Follow Aeternitas, a strange humanoid creature with the ability to control nature, on the day before her last assignment. Help her make a final decision.

[From [url=https://infinite-mosaic.itch.io/springtide-sacrament]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃特爾妮塔絲是個奇異的人形生物，擁有操縱自然的能力。在她執行最後一次任務的前一天，陪著她，幫她做出最後的決定。

［摘自[url=https://infinite-mosaic.itch.io/springtide-sacrament]itch.io[/url]］
